age_limit.details: Maximum Age: 42 years for all posts. Age will be calculated as on 01 September 2026. | Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

qualification.details: Assistant cum Bench Clerk: Bachelor's Degree in Science, Arts, Commerce, Engineering, Medicine or any other discipline from a recognized University (10+2+3 or 11+1+3 pattern); Must have passed Computer on Office Automation recognized by Government; Must possess Diploma or Degree in Computer Education from Government or Government-recognized institution. Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk: Passed 10th Standard (SSLC) from a Government or Government-recognized school or equivalent qualification. Office Assistant: Passed 8th Standard from a Government or Government-recognized school or equivalent qualification.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Tiruchirappalli Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://tiruchirappalli.nic.in/.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Tiruchirappalli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the application form for DCPU Tiruchirappalli Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is 07 October 2026.

faq.answer: The posts available are Assistant cum Bench Clerk, Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk, and Office Assistant.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for DCPU Tiruchirappalli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for DCPU Tiruchirappalli Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to send their applications by post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DCPU Tiruchirappalli Various Posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for DCPU Tiruchirappalli Various Posts is 42 years. Age will be calculated as on 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Assistant cum Bench Clerk post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Assistant cum Bench Clerk post is Rs. 25,000/- Per Month.

faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10th Standard (SSLC) from a Government or Government-recognized school or equivalent qualification.

faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for DCPU Tiruchirappalli Recruitment 2026.

faq.answer: The selection process for DCPU Tiruchirappalli Various Posts Recruitment 2026 primarily involves Document Verification.
